The perspective_distortion is minor but noticeable in the relative sizing of the fish. The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions, but this doesn't mean the image is artifact-free. I would increase the severity of the texture_anomaly to 2 and the perspective_distortion to 2, given the pose auditor's findings.
